sloka: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो मेघाश्च खरनिःस्वनाः ।प्रबभौ न च सूर्यो वै महोल्काश्चापतन्भुवि ।। ७.९.३० ॥
transliteration: vavarṣa rudhiraṁ devo meghāśca kharaniḥsvanāḥ ।prababhau na ca sūryo vai maholkāścāpatanbhuvi ।। 7.9.30 ॥

translations.english: The sky rained blood, clouds roared harshly, the sun did not shine, and great meteors fell upon the earth.
